summary.text: Ryan Elkins is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Elkins advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary for District 30 with 566 votes in a race with no other Democrat, and he faces incumbent Republican Jeff Eldridge in the general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Elkins listed his key campaign messages as putting families and communities ahead of corporate interests, building infrastructure and expanding behavioral health services, and responding to the opioid crisis.
The survey response describes him as someone in long-term recovery who would advocate for recovery programs and mental health support.
He named behavioral health and addiction recovery, economic development and infrastructure, and education and youth programs as his policy interests.
